summary: Stream searches can miss matches spanning buffer boundaries when a rare-byte prefilter finds no candidate and leaves the automaton state unupdated before the buffer rolls. The added regression test places "1234j" at offset 8191, crossing the 8192-byte buffer boundary. The fix disables prefilters that may search for non-starting match bytes during streaming, preserving automaton state across buffers. Reversing only the stream prefilter initialization restores the faulty behavior while preserving the upstream test. No tests were executed.
